## Service pages
- [Hot Water Repairs & System Replacement Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/hot-water-problems-perth.html): Hot water repairs and system replacement in Perth. Our local plumbing and electrical team assesses the fault and provides a repair plan and written quote.
- [Blocked Drains Perth — Drain Clearing & Repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/blocked-drains-perth.html): Blocked drain clearing and drain repairs in Perth for slow sinks, showers and backed-up drainage. Book an on-site assessment and written quote.
- [Water Leak Detection Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/water-leak-detection-perth.html): Water leak detection in Perth for damp areas, visible leaks and suspected concealed pipe faults. Arrange an inspection, repair scope and written quote.
- [Burst Pipe Repairs Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/burst-pipe-repair-perth.html): Burst pipe repairs in Perth for active pipe leaks and damaged water connections. Contact our local team for assessment, repair scope and a written quote.
- [Tap & Mixer Repairs Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/tap-mixer-repairs-perth.html): Tap and mixer repairs in Perth for dripping, leaking or faulty kitchen, bathroom and laundry fittings. Book an assessment and written repair quote.
- [Toilet Repairs Perth — Cistern & Flush Repairs](https://perthpipepower.com.au/toilet-repairs-perth.html): Toilet repairs in Perth for leaks, running cisterns, slow filling, blockages and overflow. On-site assessment, repair or maintenance plan and written quote.
- [Electrical Fault Finding & Power Repairs Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/power-faults-perth.html): Electrical fault finding and power repairs in Perth for outages, circuit faults and recurring trips. Book a licensed electrician assessment and written quote.
- [Safety Switch & RCD Repairs Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/safety-switch-tripping-perth.html): Safety switch and RCD repairs in Perth for recurring trips and switches that will not stay on. Arrange fault assessment, repair scope and a written quote.
- [Lighting & Power Point Repairs and Installation Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/lighting-power-points-perth.html): Lighting and power point repairs and installation in Perth. Discuss fittings, outlet locations and circuit requirements, with an on-site written quote.
- [Smoke Alarm Repairs, Replacement & Maintenance Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/smoke-alarm-maintenance-perth.html): Smoke alarm repairs, replacement and maintenance in Perth. On-site assessment, repair plan and written quote. Do not remove hardwired units.
- [Fixture, Tap & Appliance Connection Services in Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/fixtures-appliances-perth.html): Fixture and appliance connections in Perth: taps, toilets, showers, kitchens and laundries. Discuss plumbing and electrical scope and get a written quote.
- [Smart Home & Energy Electrical Services in Perth](https://perthpipepower.com.au/renewables-smart-home-perth.html): Smart home and energy electrical services in Perth. Discuss lighting controls, automation and equipment connections, with assessed scope and written quotes.
